crops.feature: lamp cluster, viewer's left (m<0, train's right)
crops.reading: One figure-of-eight bezel in a yellow plate a shade lighter than the panel, black outline, 8 screws. Large round headlamp (lit, warm white) outboard and higher; small round LED tail lamp (grey dot matrix, unlit) inboard and lower, about 0.6 the headlamp's diameter.
crops.reading2: Peanut/figure-8 yellow bezel, thin dark outline, 8 screws; big lamp (lit) left/outboard and higher, small grey LED lamp right and lower (about 0.24 vs 0.37 of the crop).

crops.feature: lamp cluster, viewer's right (m>0, train's left)
crops.reading: Mirror of the left cluster: large clear faceted headlamp outboard (towards the body edge, right) and higher, small LED tail lamp (5x6 dots, unlit) inboard and lower; yellow plate, black outline, 8 screws.
crops.reading2: Mirror-image peanut bezel; big clear prismatic lamp right and higher, small LED-grid lamp left and lower; about 8 screws.

crops.feature: windscreen band: three panes, pillars, black strip
crops.reading: One black band from the orange line down to a black strip under the glass, three panes split by two thin pillars; panes look 0.33/0.28/0.26 of the crop wide only by perspective (fit: equal, 0.80 m). Three pantograph wipers pivoting on the strip: left and centre arms park up and to the right, the right arm up and to the left. Orange LED destination display at the top of the left pane. Settled: equal panes from the projective fit.
crops.reading2: 3 panes with pillars (0.33/0.28/0.26 of crop); 3 wipers, left and centre lean up-right, right leans up-left; destination display top of left pane; orange line along the top dipping at the ends.

crops.feature: left windscreen pane (m<0) with destination display and wiper
crops.reading: Left pane, near-square corners in a thin black seal inside the black band; destination display across its top; wiper pivot bottom middle, arm up-right with a tall blade.
crops.reading2: Rectangular pane, slight radii (~0.03), thin frame; display at top; wiper pivots bottom, leans up-right.

crops.feature: centre windscreen pane and wiper
crops.reading: Centre pane, square-ish corners, thin frame; wiper pivots bottom centre, arm up-right.
crops.reading2: Taller pane, small radii, iridescent glass; wiper pivots bottom middle, leans up-right.

crops.feature: right windscreen pane (m>0) and wiper
crops.reading: Right pane, square-ish corners; the arch inside is the cab's sun-blind housing seen through the glass, not the glass outline; wiper pivots bottom right, parks up-left. The orange line drops diagonally at the corner.
crops.reading2: Pane with slight radius; arched dark shape top left inside; wiper pivots bottom right leaning up-left; orange line drops at the right.

crops.feature: warning yellow: extent, corners, edges
crops.reading: One yellow band from the bottom of the black strip (straight top edge, square top corners at the face corners) down to a straight bottom edge just below the lamps; outer bottom corners a large radius (~0.2 m); navy below. Number top left; a navy slotted bracket right of centre at the bottom.
crops.reading2: Yellow panel, straight top, bottom left corner curves in, right side curves in; number top left; clusters left and right; small dark hook bottom centre-right; dark blue below.

crops.feature: unit number
crops.reading: '376 035' in a dark navy-black medium-weight sans-serif, top left of the yellow, above the left cluster.
crops.reading2: '376 035', dark navy/black medium-bold sans-serif.

crops.feature: lower front: navy valance, coupler recess, coupler
crops.reading: Navy lower front: two rounded bumper blocks with a horizontal crease, a central rectangular recess (about 1 m wide) holding the grey Dellner coupler head with two round openings and a black cylinder below.
crops.reading2: Dark blue lower front, rounded bumper blocks, central recessed opening with a grey coupler (two holes) and black cylinder.

crops.feature: roof dome and marker light
crops.reading: Navy roof dome; a raised D-shaped surround (flat bottom, round top) outlined by a thin bright line, holding a grey-white oval marker lens about half its width.
crops.reading2: D/teardrop recess with pale outline, flat bottom; smaller grey-white oval lens inside, unlit.

crops.feature: navy above the screens, orange line over the band
crops.reading: Navy above the screens (no yellow cap, unlike the 377); the D-shaped marker on top; thin orange line along the top of the band, turning up at both corners into the cantrail line.
crops.reading2: Blue dome, D-shaped lamp recess at top centre; orange stripe bending up at both ends.

crops.feature: bracket on the yellow under the centre
crops.reading: A navy lamp-iron bracket: tall rounded-top plate with a vertical slot, on a smaller slotted link to the navy below.
crops.reading2: Dark navy hook: rounded-top bracket with vertical slot plus a smaller slotted link below.

crops.feature: face corner, viewer's right
crops.reading: Viewer's right face corner: navy body rounding back from the yellow and the band; orange line turns up round the corner.

crops.feature: train's right side behind the corner: cab door, orange panel
crops.reading: Train's right side behind the corner: plain navy cab side (latch and step only, no window), cab door with one tall barred window, then the orange-ringed saloon window with the thick orange panel over it, then door 1 (open, light blue edge).
crops.reading2: From the front: glossy navy panel with latch, door gap, tall narrow door window, then window with orange panel over it, light blue strip.

crops.feature: whole face, three-quarter
crops.reading: Whole face three-quarter: navy above the band and below the yellow, three panes, three wipers, figure-of-eight clusters, number top left.

crops.feature: near lamp cluster (train's right)
crops.reading: Near cluster (train's right): headlamp outboard, higher; LED tail inboard, lower; yellow plate, black outline.

crops.feature: far lamp cluster (train's left)
crops.reading: Far cluster (train's left): headlamp outboard (towards the far corner), tail inboard.

crops.feature: cab corner, cab door and first door, train's right side
crops.reading: Train's right side: face corner, plain navy cab side with latch and sticker (no window), cab door with one barred window, then the orange-ringed window section, then door 1 with an orange head.
crops.reading2: No window between corner and cab door; plain navy, sticker, latch; cab door with one tall window split by a bar; then orange outlined window block.

crops.feature: cab side ahead of the cab door, train's right side (no window)
crops.reading: Plain navy panel ahead of the cab door (right side): latch and a sticker only.
crops.reading2: Plain navy, no window; sticker, latch with blue handle.

crops.feature: cab door, train's right side
crops.reading: Cab door, navy, one tall window split by a transom about 40% down, yellow grab rail visible inside; full height to the cantrail line; flush, no outside rail.
crops.reading2: Navy cab door, one tall window split 40/60 by a bar, yellow rail inside; latch lower right.

crops.feature: orange panel and ringed first saloon window
crops.reading: Orange outline round the first saloon window: thick top panel (with a tan vent), thin vertical bars both ends, a thin bottom bar; inside, navy then black frame with a narrow pane at the rear and a wide pane at the front with a hopper. Settled: top 0.24 m, bars ~0.05 m, bottom 0.04 m.
crops.reading2: Thick orange top band (~0.12 of height) with vent; thin left/right lines; medium bottom band; narrow left window + wide right with hopper; button panel at the far left.

crops.feature: first passenger door (car 1)
crops.reading: Door 1: two light-blue leaves, each with one tall narrow dark window; orange head above (car 1 door 1 only). Reader 2 put the windows to the left of each leaf: settled on the 6x zoom (c376/w/d1.png): the front leaf's front part is hidden behind the opening's reveal from this angle, so the windows are about centred in each leaf.
crops.reading2: Two pale blue leaves, curved seam; tall narrow window per leaf placed towards each leaf's left; orange head above.

crops.feature: second passenger door (car 1)
crops.reading: Door 2: same light-blue leaves and windows, head above is navy (no orange).
crops.reading2: Pale blue two-leaf door, navy head with orange stripe at top, button panel right.

crops.feature: window band between the doors
crops.reading: Between the doors: narrow pane, three wide panes with hoppers, narrow pane, all flush black-framed.

crops.feature: car 1 rear end and car 2 front
crops.reading: Car end: body tapers in at the corner, navy, a dark gap to car 2; the light grey roof runs to the end, the orange cantrail line continues on car 2.
crops.reading2: Gap between coaches, white/grey roof, orange stripe, dark navy wedge.

crops.feature: leading bogie
crops.reading: Leading bogie under the cab: grey frame, axleboxes hidden behind frames; not usable for axle picks.

crops.feature: roof line and cantrail
crops.reading: Saloon roof light grey/white with flat equipment covers; only the cab dome is navy. Orange cantrail line along the top of the navy side.

crops.feature: train's left side (navy 376031): fixed cab window and cab door
crops.reading: Train's LEFT side (376031): small fixed window ahead of the cab door, then the cab door (window with transom, yellow rail inside, 'H'), then the orange ring's front bar.
crops.reading2: Yes, small window ahead of the door; door with barred window; orange panel at right edge.

crops.feature: fixed cab-side window, train's left
crops.reading: Fixed cab-side window: black glazing in a rounded rectangle, top-front corner radius large (~0.08 m), bottom-front smaller, rear corners square against the door seal; cream interior frame visible through it.
crops.reading2: Black frame, large top-left radius (~0.12 of width), smaller bottom-left (~0.06), square right corners.

crops.feature: train's right side (white 376026): cab door, no window ahead
crops.reading: Train's RIGHT side (white 376026): no window between the corner and the cab door; cab door with transom window, plain panel with latch.
crops.reading2: No window between the door and the front; door with barred window.

crops.feature: nose profile side-on (navy)
crops.reading: Navy nose in profile: yellow face standing about 0.05 m ahead of the band at lamp height, the band leaning back gently, dome rounding back; navy valance below the yellow, its bottom sweeping back.

crops.feature: orange panel and ring, train's left
crops.reading: Ring front end, left side: thick top panel, front vertical bar, thin bottom bar; navy inside, black window frame.
crops.reading2: Thick orange top band, thin left strip, thinnest bottom band; navy panel inside.

crops.feature: lower cab side and valance, side-on
crops.reading: Valance side-on: navy block with a round lamp-like fitting, bottom sweeping back towards the front.

crops.feature: lamp cluster viewer's left, lit tail
crops.reading: Lamps lit as tail: small LED lamp lit red, inboard; headlamp outboard, higher, unlit.
crops.reading2: Small lamp lit red, inboard (towards the centre); big lamp upper, unlit.

crops.feature: lamp cluster viewer's right, lit tail
crops.reading: Same: red LED tail inboard and lower, clear headlamp outboard and higher.
crops.reading2: Red lamp inboard, big lamp outboard and higher.

crops.feature: destination display
crops.reading: Orange LED destination display, black background, rectangular.

crops.feature: train's left side: fixed window, cab door, orange panel, door 1
crops.reading: Left side: small window ahead of the cab door, cab door, orange ring, door 1 with orange head and light blue leaves.
crops.reading2: Small window ahead of cab door; cab door; orange ring; pale blue leaf with orange head.

crops.feature: train's left side cab end, sunlit
crops.reading: Left side, sunlit: window ahead of cab door, door, ring with vent, door 1 light blue with orange head.
crops.reading2: Small window ahead; cab door; orange panel with vent; pale blue leaf, orange head.

crops.feature: face near frontal (telephoto)
crops.reading: Near frontal: same face, used for proportions only.

crops.feature: car 2 doors and ends
crops.reading: Car 2: navy, light blue leaves, no orange shapes; narrow/wide/wide/wide/narrow panes between the doors.

crops.feature: train's right side: corner, cab door, orange panel, door 1 (open)
crops.reading: Right side: plain cab side, cab door, orange ring, door 1 open.
crops.reading2: No window ahead of the cab door; cab door; orange-outlined window block; open door at left.

crops.feature: door 1 open, leaf and pocket
crops.reading: Door 1 open: leaves slide into the bodyside; inner face cream with yellow grab rails.
crops.reading2: Open door, cream inner leaf, yellow handrails.

crops.feature: train's left side: fixed window and cab door
crops.reading: Left side: fixed window ahead of the cab door confirmed.
crops.reading2: Small window ahead of the cab door.

crops.feature: southeastern wordmark, cab car, right side
crops.reading: lower-case 'southeastern' in one word below the window line between doors 2 and 3: 'south' white, 'eastern' light blue; reads normally, so 'south' is the rear half on this side. Ascenders reach ~1383 px, baseline ~1410 px; no descenders.

crops.feature: southeastern wordmark, cab car, left side
crops.reading: same wordmark, same place between doors 2 and 3, reading normally ('south' at the front end on this side); jpeg-blocky but the white/blue split is clear.

crops.feature: southeastern wordmark, next car, left side
crops.reading: the next car carries the same wordmark mid-bodyside between its two doors, under the window line, at the same height as on the cab car.

crops.feature: southeastern wordmark, next car, right side (far, foreshortened)
crops.reading: wordmark visible mid-bodyside between the next car's doors on the right side too, too small to measure.

crops.feature: wheelchair pictograms flanking cab-car door 2, right side
crops.reading: two small blue squares with a white wheelchair, one each side of door 2 (the accessible door), on the bodyside just clear of the door edges, below the window line.

crops.feature: wheelchair pictograms flanking cab-car door 2, left side
crops.reading: the same blue wheelchair squares either side of door 2 on the left side; the next car's doors carry none (logo-se-next-010).
